title: Ramsey-type $χ$-bounds for $χ$-bounded graph classes
summary: We prove that for every path $P$, the class of graphs with no induced $P$ and no induced four-cycle $C_4$ is linearly $χ$-bounded. More generally, we ask for which pairs $\{T,H\}$ where $T$ is a forest and $H$ is a complete multipartite graph, every graph $G$ with no induced $T$ and no induced $H$ has chromatic number at most $C \cdot R(α(H),ω(G)+1)$ for some constant $C$ depending only on $T$ and $H$, where $R(\cdot,\cdot)$ denotes the usual Ramsey numbers.
